test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In how many years will the interest on a certain sum of money at 5% p.a. be three-eights of itself? (Express your answer in years and months)
solution:
Given:

Rate of interest = 5%

Interest incurred = three-eights of the principal

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be Rs. P and time required be T years.

According to the question,

{P times 5 times T} over 100 = {3 over 8} times P 

⇒ T = 7.5 

Hence, time required = 7.5 years = 7 years 6 months

**∴ In 7 years 6 months the interest on a certain sum of money at 5% p.a. will be three-eights of itself.**
